Name: Yosin's TerrariaWeapon
Author: Zerone998
Description:
算是个人喜好吧，泰拉的武器很多都挺好看的，可是一直都没有人做这个mod，所以我就自己动手了，
第一次作画&第一次做MOD，很简单的mod，希望大家喜欢。

需要SMAPI和JsonAssets，解压压缩包，把[JA]Yosin's TerrariaWeapon文件夹放进MODS里面就可以用了。

提示：有些武器是分别在下水道的小黑和矿洞的矮人那里买的，最强的几把当然超级贵，其他在马龙那里有。
﻿    剩下的武器也许会慢慢更新。

I guess it's a personal preference, but tara had a lot of nice weapons, but no one ever made the mod, so I did it myself.
First drawing & first MOD, very simple MOD, hope you like it.

Install SMAPI and JsonAssets, unzip the folder in the ZIP package into the MODS folder, and you can use it.

Tip:  A few of the weapons were bought from Krobus and Dwarf, the rest from Malone's shop.
﻿The remaining weapons may be replaced slowly.
